intro: This archive collects 24 articles tagged `supply-chain-attack` published between April 13, 2026 and May 14, 2026, giving security teams a focused view of how this topic has appeared across ZCyberNews coverage. Observed actor references include GlassWorm, TeamPCP, and APT37, presented only where the underlying article metadata supports the attribution. The affected-scope signals emphasize technology, software development, and cybersecurity across Global, China, and South korea, helping readers compare exposure patterns without adding claims beyond the archive data. Severity coverage includes 7 critical, and 17 high reports.
